hints: CH340G needs an external 12 MHz crystal (11.98–12.02 MHz at XI) between XI and XO with a capacitor from each pin to GND – 33 pF for a quartz crystal (p. 3, p. 5, p. 9, p. 10); the CH340C in the same package has the clock built in. Transmit baud-rate error < 0.3 % with the crystal (p. 7)

two supply modes (p. 5): 5 V – VCC 4.0–5.3 V, V3 only to a 0.1 µF capacitor; 3.3 V – V3 joined to VCC and every circuit on the CH340's I/O at most 3.3 V. Between 3.6 V and 4.0 V the data sheet specifies neither; vdd_op_min_v … vdd_op_max_v spans both modes and does not see that gap

the I/O pins are not 5 V tolerant on a 3.3 V supply (VIO ≤ VCC + 0.5 V, p. 8) except CH340C/N of lot numbers starting with 4 and the CH340X (p. 5); a 5 V-supplied CH340 drives 5 V into a 3.3 V microcontroller's RX

powered separately from the microcontroller, current flows back through the I/O pins; the data sheet's dual supply circuits (7.7, p. 13) add diodes and an NMOS – or power both from one supply (7.6, p. 12)
